one_liner: Reducto is a document parsing/extraction REST API with a free Studio tier (15,000 credits), self-serve bearer API keys, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Static API key created in Studio and sent as Authorization: Bearer. Workload identity federation (OIDC token exchange at /oauth/token for short-lived tokens) is also available to every org, but it is not an OAuth app flow for third-party multi-user access. The CLI/MCP --login uses a device-code flow that only saves an API key locally.
access_notes: The homepage says to get started free with 15,000 credits in Studio, and the Studio sidebar creates API keys. The earlier "$150 / no credit card" claim came from a signup page that is not among the provided pages, so I could not verify it. Pricing beyond the free credits is not settled by these pages.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Each user supplies their own API key, since there is no OAuth app flow.

evidence.quote: Use the key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for HTTP calls, set `REDUCTO_API_KEY` for SDKs and agent tools
or create one in [Studio](https://studio.reducto.ai) under API Keys.
Workload identity federation is available to every Reducto organization today.
Get started free with 15,000 credits at https://studio.reducto.ai/.
[OpenAPI specification](https://reducto.ai/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 schema for the Reducto API.
Process documents asynchronously with webhooks for high-volume workloads.
The Reducto MCP server connects AI agents directly to Reducto.
